_readme.title: NotYVOS Roadmap
_readme.howto: Update phase status and scope here. The roadmap page and host deployment read this file as the canonical roadmap data.

phases.name: Kernel Foundation
phases.description: Native x86-64 kernel foundation, boot path, interrupts, CPU/SMP and core kernel services.

phases.name: Memory Management
phases.description: PMM, VMM, paging, higher-half mappings and kernel heap foundation.

phases.name: Scheduler
phases.description: Task scheduling, execution infrastructure and process isolation foundation.

phases.name: Storage Foundation
phases.description: VFS, initramfs and the initial NYFS storage path.

phases.name: Graphics Foundation
phases.description: Graphics HAL, framebuffer rendering and compositor foundation.

phases.name: Desktop Foundation
phases.description: Desktop shell, windows, Explorer, Settings, dialogs and core interaction.

phases.name: PS3 Runtime Foundation
phases.description: PS3 ABI, PPU/SPU execution, DMA, JIT and RSX runtime foundations.

phases.name: GameRunner Foundation
phases.description: GameRunner integration with the PS3 runtime and native graphics services.

phases.name: Image Decoders
phases.description: BMP, PNG, GIF, ICO and JPEG support in the native image pipeline.

phases.name: SVG + Icons
phases.description: SVG rendering and native desktop icon infrastructure.

phases.name: TrueType
phases.description: Native TrueType rendering and the Inter desktop font path.

phases.name: Explorer 10G
phases.description: Explorer grid/details view, breadcrumbs and real VFS file operations.

phases.name: Clipboard + Dialogs
phases.description: Global clipboard routing, text/file transfers and desktop dialogs.

phases.name: GameRunner Integration
phases.description: Game session lifecycle, configuration persistence and NYFS save-data integration.

phases.name: USB + Unified Input
phases.description: xHCI, USB enumeration, HID keyboard/mouse, mass storage and unified input.

phases.name: Networking
phases.description: Ethernet, ARP, IPv4, ICMP, UDP, TCP, DHCP, DNS and socket foundations.

phases.name: Wi-Fi
phases.description: Native wireless networking, device management and desktop integration.

phases.name: Bluetooth
phases.description: Bluetooth transport and supported input-device integration.

phases.name: NYFS Maturity
phases.description: Journaling, crash recovery, scaling and filesystem integrity improvements.

phases.name: Firewall
phases.description: Native firewall policy, filtering and Settings integration.

phases.name: NotYFirm
phases.description: Native firmware domain and the next-stage boot/runtime boundary.
